sentences.text: 4. Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.280 of 2024, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and 5(j)(ii)/6 POCSO Act, Police Station- Gursahaiganj, District- Kannauj, during the pendency of trial.

5. As per prosecution story, the applicant is stated to have enticed away the victim on 29.4.2024 at about 08:00 p.m.
6.
Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He has nothing to do with the said offence.
The FIR is delayed by about four days and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant has further stated that the victim is a consenting party as is but evident from her statement recorded U/s 164 Cr.P.C., whereby she has stated that she had gone with the applicant all the way to Baroda, Gujarat and stayed with him and she was pregnant at that time.
Subsequently, the statement of the victim was recorded in court as PW-1, whereby she has stated that she has given birth to a baby-girl and expressed her willingness to stay with the applicant only.
As such, it is a clear cut case of consent.
8. It is further argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the victim is major aged about 18 years.
The applicant is ready to take care of the victim and his daughter duo after his release from jail.
There is no criminal antecedent of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 13.12.2024 and he is ready to cooperate with trial.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
9. Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application.

10. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, the evidence on record, taking into consideration the statement of the victim recorded in court as also that the applicant is ready to take care of the victim and his daughter after his release from jail, and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

11. Let the applicant- Amar Ali, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with evidence during trial.
(ii) The applicant shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
(iii) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed.
12. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
